title: ASN.1 object identifier registry
description: Known arcs of the object identifier tree, used for the completion of object identifier values. Uniqueness of `name` and `number` among the children of one node cannot be expressed in JSON Schema and is checked by the tests.

roots.description: The arcs directly below the root of the object identifier tree.

node.description: One arc of the object identifier tree.

name.description: The name form of the arc (identifier, e.g. `iso`): starts with a lower case letter, may contain digits and single hyphens.

number.description: The number form of the arc.

description.description: Short description of the arc, shown in the completion popup.

children.description: The arcs directly below this arc.
